exit.note: Doc 48 S2 beat 3: 'and he walks.' Off the hill at the right, unhurried, his hat in his hand (room-31 operation 3, cut by tools/art/cut-walk-sheet.py).
exit.redrawn: His own walk (art/actors/hob-walk-right, cast-unify 37), lantern in hand and hat on, relit once into the night.
exit.walkNote: WALK-C (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "Hob at the funeral isn't great"): six frames posed on Thad's walk (cast-unify 46): six frames posed on Thad's walk (cast-unify 44), cut by tools/art/walk-c.py; strideRatio MEASURED FROM THESE FRAMES (R5f): the planted foot's travel against the body over a cycle, against the same measure on Thad's walk (whose recorded 0.588 it calibrates); so the cycle advances with the ground he covers and his feet hold it.
exit.speedNote: One Hob, one pace: his own walkSpeed in Room 1 as a share of his height (134 / 240 = 0.558 a second), at the funeral's man (347 px): 194 px/s. Was 70, and his legs scooted.
